audit: Sprint 3.13 Proposal Claim and Limitation Registry
pilot_scope_statement: Q-VLA Forge Phase-1 is a pilot-scale controlled experimental framework using synthetic autonomous-driving and robotics proxy tasks. It isolates and compares classical, quantum-inspired, and later hybrid QML components under reproducible conditions. Results must not be interpreted as validation of a production-scale VLA, autonomous-driving stack, robotic system, or functional-safety certification.

claims.statement: The shared VLA proxy architecture operates in both autonomous-driving and robotics proxy domains.
claims.evidence_basis: Sprint 1 established the same shared architecture with domain-specific state adapters and one common multimodal latent/action stack.

claims.statement: The FP32 baseline was validated using deterministic seeds 42, 123, and 456 in both proxy domains.
claims.evidence_basis: Sprint 1 baseline manifest and validation summary.

claims.statement: INT8 achieved approximately 3.846x effective whole-model storage compression.
claims.evidence_basis: Sprint 2 three-seed compression validation.

claims.statement: INT8 satisfied the frozen >=2x compression and <=5% relative MSE-change criterion in all three seeds in both proxy domains.
claims.evidence_basis: Sprint 2 compression validation summary.

claims.statement: Trainable TT/MPS reduced trainable parameter count by approximately 44.46% in both proxy domains.
claims.evidence_basis: Sprint 3 three-seed structured-training evidence.

claims.statement: In the seed-42 matched-parameter ablation, TT/MPS produced lower validation and test MSE than matched SVD in both proxy domains.
claims.evidence_basis: Sprint 3 matched-budget ablation; seed 42 only, and neither representation reached the paired FP32 convergence target.

claims.statement: The same architecture can reuse common computational modules across both proxy domains.
claims.evidence_basis: Cross-domain Sprint 1-3 architecture evidence. This does not imply one universally trained model.

claims.statement: Measured latency for the compact synthetic proxy model was below 100 ms in both domains.
claims.evidence_basis: Sprint 1 mean and p95 latency measurements on the 76,179-parameter proxy model. This is not production deployment validation.

claims.statement: The pilot does not establish quantum advantage.
claims.evidence_basis: TT/MPS was executed classically and no quantum hardware comparison was performed.

claims.statement: The pilot does not establish quantum speedup.
claims.evidence_basis: No quantum-runtime benchmark has been performed.

claims.statement: The pilot does not establish native TT/MPS runtime acceleration.
claims.evidence_basis: Sprint 2 TT/MPS inference reconstructs dense FP32 weights, and Sprint 3 TT/MPS does not claim native runtime speedup.

claims.statement: The pilot does not establish native INT8 runtime acceleration.
claims.evidence_basis: Sprint 2 uses FP32-dequantized weights for inference.

claims.statement: The pilot does not establish an SVD training-efficiency advantage.
claims.evidence_basis: Driving SVD required more optimizer steps on average, and robotics SVD reached the paired target in 0/3 seeds.

claims.statement: The pilot does not establish a TT/MPS training-efficiency advantage.
claims.evidence_basis: TT/MPS reached the paired FP32 target in 0/3 seeds in both proxy domains.

claims.statement: The pilot does not establish performance on a production-scale VLA.
claims.evidence_basis: Experiments use a compact synthetic proxy architecture.

claims.statement: The pilot does not establish production autonomous-driving performance.
claims.evidence_basis: No production driving stack or real-world benchmark was evaluated.

claims.statement: The pilot does not establish production robotics performance.
claims.evidence_basis: No production robotics stack or real-world benchmark was evaluated.

claims.statement: The pilot does not establish ISO 26262, IEC 62061, or ISO 10218 compliance or certification.
claims.evidence_basis: Functional-safety certification has not been performed.

claims.statement: Classical PPO sample efficiency has not yet been tested.
claims.evidence_basis: Planned for Sprint 4.

claims.statement: Hybrid PQC/VQC policy sample efficiency has not yet been tested.
claims.evidence_basis: Planned for Sprint 4.

claims.statement: A hybrid QML policy advantage has not yet been tested.
claims.evidence_basis: Planned for Sprint 4.

claims.statement: Lyapunov safety-filter improvement has not yet been tested.
claims.evidence_basis: Planned for Sprint 5.

claims.statement: Robustness under Gaussian, state, and action perturbations has not yet been tested.
claims.evidence_basis: Planned for Sprint 5.

claims.statement: Cross-domain RL consistency has not yet been tested.
claims.evidence_basis: Planned for Sprint 4.
